title: Know Your Internship Rights
selection_rationale: Creates an open loop that earns the next few seconds.

heygen_settings.captions: no on-screen text in the rendered video; captions can be platform-native after upload
heygen_settings.rendering: scene-by-scene HeyGen generation, then stitch in Canva or CapCut

spoken_script: Confused about your rights during internships? I will show you how to understand and assert your legal rights. First: UK law requires payment for work that meets employment criteria. Second: Communicating rights can prevent exploitation. Third: Knowledge empowers you to negotiate fair terms. The rule is simple: Research your rights and communicate them confidently to employers. Learn more about internship rights at internwise.co.uk.

production_notes: Open with direct eye contact and no intro logo.
Generate each scene as a separate HeyGen clip because single shots are capped at 15 seconds.
Use light background music behind the voice and keep it low enough that speech stays clear.
Do not add on-screen text to the video.
Do not say 'link in bio' in the video. Put it only in IG/TikTok captions if needed.
No em dashes in captions or overlays.
